description_en: Grants a license to a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定产品授权License
name: BindLicenseProduct

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Enterprise instance. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 企业版实例的实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: 480P and 720P
parameters.help_zh: License类型（音视频规格），可取值：480P、720P
parameters.name: license_code

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which you want to grant a license.

You can view the information about all products in the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
待授权的产品的ProductKey。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息
parameters.name: product_key

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见本文下方的错误码

Data.description_en:
Indicates whether the license is granted to the product.
true: The license is granted to the product.
false: The license failed to be granted to the product
Data.description_zh:
表示产品授权License是否成功。
true：产品授权License成功。
false：产品授权License失败

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
